The postoperative sentence says "After surgery" without stating which operation, its date or its indication; the intussusception is named in the preceding sentence.
The HSA solution given at the other clinic had an unknown dose and no stated route or schedule.
The authors call the delayed type III hypersensitivity reaction suspected/supported; a kidney biopsy was not performed, and glomerulonephritis is discussed but not diagnosed.
The authors state that the influence of IA on the disease course could not be completely objectively determined and that hemodialysis alone might have improved kidney values.
